t: Din taanit vedin taanit chalom beshabbat
s: Din taanit vedin taanit chalom beshabbat ubo y"d seipim: tzarik lemaher leekol sop shaa shishshit, sheasur lehitannot beshabbat ad chatzot, apillu im eno mitkavven leshum taanit ella shennimna mechamat osqo bedabar acher, apillu hu debar mitzva, kegon sheqqore umitpallel — asur. Ella im ken eno chapetz leekol adayin vehaichur hu oneg lo, kemo sheyyitbaer (vehu haddin im mitanneg biqria utepilla yoter mibbaakila). Veim mitkavven leshem taanit — apillu shaa achat asur:

Adam shehaakila mazzeqet lo sheaz oneg hu lo shello leekol — eno tzarik leekol kelal, vekimat sheasur lo leekol, shello yitztaer beshabbat. Veken mi shemmitanneh bekol yom vaakila beshabbat tzaar hu lo mippene shinnuy veset — yakol lehitannot gam beshabbat, shemmitzvat seuddot shabbat enah ella bishbil oneg. Abal beinyan acher asur lehitannot beshabbat, apillu mechamat teshuba vachasidut, ap al pi sheyyesh lo taanug betaanit zeh — en lo lehachalip oneg chakamim shettiqqenu beg' seuddot beoneg acher sheeno mukrach sheyyihyeh beshabbat velo hittiruhu chakamim:

Abal muttar lehitannot taanit chalom beshabbat keshechalam bo bayyom, sheyyapeh taanit lachalom lebattel haggezar din keesh linoret im mitanneh bo bayyom, vehittiru lo chakamim bishbil sheyyiqqara gezar dino. Veod, lepi sheen kan bittul oneg shabbat legamre, kevan shennapsho aguma alayv bishbil chalomo im lo yitanneh, veim yitanneh batuach hu sheyyiqqara gezar dino — im ken hare hattaanit hazzeh taanug hu lo. Umikkol maqom, ap sheqqoreim gezar dino — chozerim venipraim mimmennu al shebbittel iqqar oneg shabbat. Umah taqqanato? Yitanneh od taanit bechol sheyyitkapper lo. Ulekattechilla tzarik lehitannot miyyad lemachar beyom rishon, sheen rauy lo lehitakkeb lebaqqesh selicha vekappara. Ella im ken tashash kocho veeno yakol lehitannot b' yamim zeh achar zeh — yakol lehitannot achar kak kesheyyechazzeq kocho. Vekol shekken im haya beyom rishon chanukka, o purim, o ereb yom hakkippurim, o rosh chodesh, o chullo shel moed, vekol shekken yom tob, apillu yom tob b' shel galuyyot, shello yitanneh ad achar kak. Abal im lemachar hu yom sheissur hattaanit bo eno ella minhag, kegon bechodesh nisan, apillu beereb pesach o isru chag — yitanneh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tk"t. Vehu haddin bime hagbala, uben yom hakkippurim lesukkot. Vaapillu berosh chodesh nisan verosh chodesh ab yakol lehitannot, hoil veyesh mitannim bahem bekol shana taanit tzaddiqim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"p. Ubekol yamim ellu, hammitanneh bahem taanit chalom — eno tzarik lehitannot achar kak taanit al taanito kemo hammitanneh beshabbat. Abal hammitanneh taanit chalom berosh chodesh, chanukka, upurim, veyom tob, apillu yom tob b' shel galuyyot, vechullo shel moed — tzarik lehitannot achar kak taanit al taanito kemo beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqs"ch:

Hammitanneh taanit chalom beshabbat ulemachar hu taanit choba, kegon y"z betammuz, o t' beab, o asara betebet, o taanit ester shennahagu bo choba, o apillu taanit yachid shennahag bo choba, kegon mi sheyyesh lo minhag qabua lehitannot beyom a' shel selichot — eno oleh lo, kevan sheap im lo haya mitanneh beshabbat haya mitanneh taanit zeh — en taanit zeh mekapper lo al bittul oneg shabbat, shello matzinu kappara bechinnam. Veyesh choleqin al zeh. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona, veken yesh lehorot im hu ish bari sheen hattaanit mazziq lo. Abal mi sheqqasheh alayv hattaanit, im somek al hammeqillin — lo hipsid:
En lehitannot beshabbat al chalomot shehem hepsed mamon, ella al dabar shemmechallelin alayv et hashshabbat:
Im chabero raa alayv chalom ra — lo yitanneh beshabbat:

Yesh omerim sheen lehitannot taanit chalom beshabbat ella al chalom sheraahu g' peamim. Veyesh omerim shebbizman hazzeh en lehitannot taanit chalom beshabbat bekol inyan, lepi sheen anu beqiim bepitron chalomot leda ezo tob veezo ra. Veyesh omerim sheal ellu chalomot mitannin beshabbat ap bizman hazzeh, haroeh seper tora o tepillin shennisrepu, o yom hakkippurim bishat neila, o qorot beto o shinnayv shennapelu. Abal im raa lechayayv shennasheru — hare zeh simman tob, shemmetu hayyoatzim alayv raa. Veyesh omerim haroeh yom hakkippurim ap shello bishat neila. Veyesh omerim ap haroeh sheqqore beseper tora (betzibbur). Veyesh omerim ap haroeh shennose ishsha. Veyesh omerim shekkol chalomot shebbearu pitronam bigmara shehem raim — muttar lehitannot alehem beshabbat. Abal yesh omerim shennishtannu pitrone hachalomot mizzeman chakme haggemara lizmannenu, kemo shennishtannu harepuot shebbizmannehem. Veken yesh omerim sheharoeh yom hakkippurim apillu bishat neila eno chalom ra, ki hu simman yapeh shemmachalu avonotayv. Veken haroeh qorot beto shennapelu — ameru bemidrash shecholma ishsha achat kak upateru lah shetteled zakar, veken haya lah. Veyesh omerim od sheapillu hachalomot shemmitannim alehem ledibre hakkol — lo yitanneh alehem beshabbat, ella im ken hattaanit oneg lo, shennapsho aguma alayv im lo yitanneh. Ulepi sheoneg hashshabbat hu min hattora, veap lehaomerim shehu middibre qabbala kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"b, mikkol maqom lehitannot legamre ledibre hakkol asur min hattora kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"a, vetaanit chalom enah choba velo mitzva ella reshut apillu bechol, lepikak yesh lehorot ken halaka lemaaseh shello yitanneh beshabbat al shum chalom, ella im ken eno mebattel bo oneg shabbat, sheyyesh lo oneg mehattaanit yoter mimmah sheyyihyeh lo kesheyyokal veyishteh, sheyyitztaer mippachad hachalom. Abal adam sheeno mitpached kol kak mehachalom, o apillu im mitpached, ella shehattaanit qasheh lo umitztaer bo harbeh yoter mimmah shemmitztaer bepachad hachalom — asur lehitannot beshabbat al shum chalom. Veim hirher bayyom vechalam ballayla — lo yitanneh alayv beshabbat bekol inyan, sheen bazeh horaa min hashshamayim kelal:

Hammitanneh taanit chalom beshabbat — tzarik lomar "anenu" achar siyyum tepillato belo chatima. Vetob lekolelo be"lohay netzor ku'". Vetob lomar gam ken "ribbon haolamim galuy veyadua lepaneka veku'", kemo bechol. Umuttar lomar gam ken "elohay ad shello notzarti ku'", o shear baqqashot al mechilat avonot. Veyakol gam ken lehitvaddot velomar "chatati, aviti, pashati". Velo aseru lomar tachanunim beshabbat ella lebaqqesh bahem al tzerakayv, kegon al parnasa, o al repua lecholeh sheyyesh lo bebeto, vekayyotze bahem mitztzorke haggup. Abal charatat avonot tob lomar bekol yom:

Vaapillu sheelat tzerakayv hittiru im hu choleh hamsukkan sakkanat hayyom, shezzoaqim umitchannenim alayv beshabbat apillu betzibbur. Veken muttar lebarek al hacholeh hamsukkan bo bayyom. Veken hammaqsha leled, shehi mesukkenet bo bayyom. Abal choleh sheen mesukkan bo bayyom — asur lebaqqesh alayv velo leborko beshabbat, kevan sheepshar laasot ken achar hashshabbat. Abal im era laadam (beshabbat) meora shetztzarik lebaqqesh alayv rachamim miyyad — yakol apillu lippol al panayv ulebaqqesh rachamim beyachid ap al pi sheen sham sakkanat hayyom, shehare hittiru apillu lehitannot al chalom ap al pi sheen sham sakkanat hayyom, raq mippene shetztzarik lehitannot bo bayyom shechalam bo. Abal betzibbur asur lebaqqesh rachamim al hammeora kol sheen sham sakkanat hayyom. Veken im yesh bair asara shemmitannim taanit chalom beshabbat achat — lo yaasu atzman tzibbur lachazor achar echad mehem sheyyitpallel tepillat hammincha beqol ram velomar "anenu" betzibbur:
Im muttar lehitannot o lizoq ulehitchannen beshabbat al ezo tzara sheqqara lerabbim o leyachid — yitbaer besimman tqa"v:
Hammitanneh taanit chalom beshabbat — yesh lo laasoq kol hayyom battora utepilla, bishbil sheyyitkapper lo veyiqqara lo gezar dino:

Mi sheyyashen shenat tzohorayim vechalam lo chalom ra — yesh omerim shemmoil lo im yitanneh y"b shaot mishshenneor mishshenato ad emtza hallayla, veaz yabdil im oseh ken beshabbat. Vetzarik lehitannot lemachar yom shalem, ap im kebar akal seudda g' qodem shechalam vehaya rashshay shello litom od kelum beshabbat, mikkol maqom kevan shehitanna leshem taanit — abera hi beyado, vetzarik kappara betaanit yom shalem. Uben bechol uben beshabbat, keshehu oseh ken — lo yomar "anenu" bemincha, kevan sheakal kebar:

Im haqqedima leekol beshabbat qodem zeman hasseudda bechol hu oneg lo, kegon shennitakkela kebar seuddat hallayla — tzarik lehaqdim, ki zehu kebod hashshabbat shemmaqdimin zeman seuddato lizman seuddat hachol. Veim haichur mizzeman seuddat hachol hu oneg lo — tzarik leacher, vezehu kebodo, shemmitavveh leekol veokel leteabon:

Veken mi sheragil bekol yom bebasar veyayin, vahare kol yamayv keshabbat — tzarik leshannot zeman hasseudda shel shabbat mizzeman seuddat hachol, sheyyaqdim o yeacher shaa muetet, bikde shello yitztaer:
